# Continual ARC solving

Use this skill for ARC-style grid transformation instances where each task supplies a test grid, optional demonstration pairs, and a limited demo/attempt budget.

## Core procedure

1. **Record the exact grid and dimensions.** Preserve row/column coordinates (1-based in notes) and distinguish unchanged cells from transformed cells.
